metadata.title: Definitions ledger for CFTR modulator-eligibility denominators (2020-2026)
metadata.description: Quote-checked registry and regulator eligibility definitions after the 03/2026 FDA label update and July 2026 EMA decisions. Zero cross-registry arithmetic.

regulator_labels.age_rule: paediatric patients aged 2 to less than 6 years; patients aged 6 years and older
regulator_labels.variant_rule: at least one non-Class I mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene
regulator_labels.exact_eligibility_wording: Kaftrio tablets are indicated in a combination regimen with ivacaftor for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 6 years and older who have at least one non-Class I mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene. Kaftrio granules are indicated in a combination regimen with ivacaftor for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in paediatric patients aged 2 to less than 6 years who have at least one non-Class I mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene.
regulator_labels.source_citation: EMA Medicines Data JSON Report (EMEA/H/C/005269, updated 2026-08-19, European Commission decision 2026-07-23)

regulator_labels.variant_rule: at least one non-Class I mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene
regulator_labels.exact_eligibility_wording: Alyftrek tablets are indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in people aged 6 years and older who have at least one non-Class I mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene (see sections 4.2 and 5.1).
regulator_labels.source_citation: EMA Medicines Data JSON Report (EMEA/H/C/006382, updated 2026-08-19, European Commission decision 2026-07-23)

regulator_labels.age_rule: adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older
regulator_labels.variant_rule: at least one variant in the CFTR gene that is either responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data (see Table 6) or results in production of CFTR protein
regulator_labels.exact_eligibility_wording: TRIKAFTA is indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older who have a clinical diagnosis of CF and who have at least one variant in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator ( CFTR ) gene that is either responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data (see Table 6 ) or results in production of CFTR protein [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.1) ] .
regulator_labels.source_citation: openFDA Drug Label API (NDA212273 / NDA217660, SPL id b63ac090-8d8b-43a0-82d1-558127f2d598, effective_time 20260622, Indications and Usage 03/2026)

regulator_labels.age_rule: adult and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older
regulator_labels.variant_rule: at least one variant in the CFTR gene that is either responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data (see Table 5) or results in production of CFTR protein
regulator_labels.exact_eligibility_wording: ALYFTREK is indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in adult and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older who have a clinical diagnosis of CF and who have at least one variant in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator ( CFTR ) gene that is either responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data (see Table 5 ) or results in production of CFTR protein [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.1) ].
